merged_yaml:
---
".probe-job":
  tags:
  - cluster
  before_script:
  - echo "probe job $CI_JOB_NAME"
  - echo "one more line"
workflow:
  rules:
  - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH =~ /^probe\\/pipefix-.*-(base|fixed|skipci)$/"
stages:
- ".pre"
- check
- report
- ".post"
default:
  interruptible: true
variables:
  PROBE_WORD: crates
".probe-vars":
  PROBE_KIND: synthetic
probe-lint:
  tags:
  - cluster
  before_script:
  - echo "probe job $CI_JOB_NAME"
  - echo "one more line"
  extends: ".probe-job"
  stage: check
  variables:
    PROBE_KIND: synthetic
  script:
  - test -f status.sh
probe-status:
  tags:
  - cluster
  before_script:
  - echo "probe job $CI_JOB_NAME"
  - echo "one more line"
  extends: ".probe-job"
  stage: check
  script:
  - sh status.sh
probe-report:
  tags:
  - cluster
  before_script:
  - echo "probe job $CI_JOB_NAME"
  - echo "one more line"
  extends: ".probe-job"
  stage: report
  script:
  - echo "report for $PROBE_WORD"
